text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик finishes the race while still
in poor
condition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Upon finishing the race, her health takes
a turn
for the worse, and she collapses.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A campus doctor gives her a quick
examination
but is unable to determine
the cause of her
illness, cautioning her
to forgo the spring Classic
races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She weeps over not being able to deliver
her
promised victories, and we
tentatively set the fall
Kikuka Sho as her
next goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
